llm.summary: The artifacts describe disclosed ClawHub/Convex maintenance and code-review workflows with meaningful confirmation, auth, and safety gates for the high-impact actions they enable.

dimensions.detail: The skills' capabilities match their stated purposes: Convex setup/migration guidance, ClawHub staff moderation, content-rights correspondence, PR maintenance, and bundled autoreview tooling.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Some workflows can affect production moderation state, user accounts, orgs, packages, emails, and production migrations, but the instructions require explicit targets, reasons, dry runs or previews, user signoff, auth checks, and verification.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No hidden install hook, privilege escalation, persistence setup, or automatic background execution was found; executable helper scripts are bundled for the advertised autoreview workflow.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The autoreview helper may send review bundles to external AI CLIs and supports read-only inspection/web search, which is expected for code review and includes secret/path filtering and engine isolation measures.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifacts avoid unbounded persistence and privilege bypass; admin workflows use existing authenticated CLI/API paths with audit logging, and destructive production actions are gated by explicit operator confirmation.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable with repo-local skills that can guide authenticated ClawHub staff actions and send code-review bundles to configured AI review tools. Use them with the documented confirmation gates, verify the target account/skill/org/package before writes, and do not run moderation, email, or production migration steps without explicit authorization.
